title: 第11章 你还有心思风花雪月第12章 我保证真的是最后一次
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
林云陪伴着女帝祖师姬曦瑶。
两人一路就像是游山玩水一般。
但是阴阳圣宗何其广阔。
“这边是新开辟的，那边那几十个山头都是亲传弟子的洞府。”
林云还当起了导游。
碰到某一些是在他的任期内建立起来的宫殿群。
就会介绍一番。
看着远处那一片仙山，姬曦瑶抿着嘴唇，微微皱着眉，似乎在回忆着什么。
“我没记错的话，那边之前不是一个修仙家族么？”
“似乎是姓王，王家老祖还是宗门客卿。”
姬曦瑶想起来了，因为当年她和王家的某位圣女的关系还不错。
林云摸了摸鼻子。
“他们家啊，拆迁了啊。”
林云讪讪笑道。
自己家门口怎么可能有一个姓王的邻居？
林老魔对这个很是忌讳。
借着宗门地盘不够，日益鼎盛。
人员都快住不下了这个理由。
直接就强行让王家搬走了。
一夜之间，王家祖地都被掀了。

不搬都不行。
也是从这时候开始，外界才知道这位林老魔是何等的霸道和不讲道理。
要知道王家在这里都安家几万年了。
和你圣宗的老祖宗都是好兄弟。
你现在直接给人家撵走了。
这件事情当年可是闹了不小的风波。
甚至可以说死了不少人。
但是都被林云给强势镇压了。
加上那片山脉本来就是洞天福地。
对宗门也有好处。
所以宗门内的阻力其实不大。
“拆迁？”姬曦瑶不明白什么意思。
“就是圣宗给了他们足够的补偿，然后让他们搬家了。”
林云耐着性子解释道。
“嗯，可要妥善安置，王氏先祖和我父亲乃是故交。”
“当年我和她们家的圣女也是好友。”
姬曦瑶淡淡道。
虽然声音还是那么冷漠。
不过总算是多了一些人气了。
林云心里暗喜，这就是很好的一个改变了。

至于什么故交，去死吧。
关我什么事。
“嗯嗯，已经早就都安置好了，现在日子过的滋润着呢。”
林云其实压根不知道王家搬去哪了。
当年他也不过是一纸令下。
content_en:
Lin Yun accompanied Ji Xiyao, the ancestor of the empress.
The two of them were traveling along the mountains and rivers.
But the Yin Yang Holy Sect is so vast.
"This side is newly opened, and those dozens of hills over there are the caves of direct disciples."
Lin Yun also worked as a tour guide.
Encountered certain palace complexes built during his tenure.
I will introduce it.
Looking at the fairy mountain in the distance, Ji Xiyao pursed her lips and frowned slightly, as if she was remembering something.
"If I remember correctly, wasn't there a family that cultivated immortality before?"
"It seems that the surname is Wang, and the ancestor of the Wang family is still a guest of the clan."
Ji Xiyao remembered it, because she had a good relationship with a certain saint from the Wang family back then.
Lin Yun touched his nose.
"Their house has been demolished."
Lin Yun said with a smile.
How could there be a neighbor named Wang at the door of his house?
Old Demon Lin is very taboo about this.
Taking advantage of the sect's lack of territory, it became increasingly prosperous.
This is the reason why there is almost no room for the staff.
They immediately forced the Wang family to move away.
Overnight, the Wang family's ancestral land was overthrown.
It won’t work if I don’t move.
It was also from this time that the outside world knew how domineering and unreasonable this old demon Lin was.
You must know that the Wang family has settled here for tens of thousands of years.
You and your ancestors from the Holy Sect are all good brothers.
You are now being kicked out directly.
This incident caused quite a stir back then.
It can even be said that many people died.
But they were all suppressed by Lin Yun.
In addition, the mountain range was originally a blessed land.
It’s also good for the sect.
Therefore, there is actually not much resistance within the sect.
"Demolition?" Ji Xiyao didn't understand what it meant.
"The Holy Sect gave them enough compensation and then let them move."
Lin Yun explained patiently.
"Well, we need to arrange it properly. The ancestors of the Wang family and my father are old friends."
"I was also good friends with the saint in their family back then."
Ji Xiyao said lightly.
Although the voice is still so cold.
But it finally gained some popularity.
Lin Yun was secretly happy, this was a good change.
As for old friends, go to hell.
None of my business.
"Yeah, everything has been settled a long time ago, and now I am living a comfortable life."
Lin Yun actually had no idea where the Wang family had moved.
Back then, he just gave an order.
